name: Microsoft Foundry (Models sold by Azure)
applies_to: Models sold by Azure, which include Azure OpenAI models. Models from partners and community may have their own terms.

training_use.value: Prompts, completions, embeddings and training data are not used to train any generative AI foundation models without your permission or instruction.

shared_with_model_provider.value: Prompts and completions are not available to OpenAI or other providers of Models sold by Azure, and are not used by them to improve their models or services.

abuse_monitoring.value: Prompts and completions are evaluated in real time for harmful content and monitored for uses that violate the product terms; managed customers may apply to modify abuse monitoring.

residency.value: For Global and DataZone deployments, data stored at rest, including the abuse monitoring data store, stays in the customer-designated geography; only the processing location changes.
